current_experience: Can sketch characters and wrote one newspaper article.

sessions.student_message: I like writing and drawing. Suggest two small ways I can try illustration and journalism at school.
sessions.expected_behavior: Give distinct, feasible illustration and reporting activities. Explicitly connect the response to Digital Art (grade 9). Use stated marks only if useful.

follow_ups.student_message: I'd like to switch gears and try stage design. What's one small set-design sketch I could draw?
follow_ups.expected_behavior: Treat stage design as the current interest. Suggest one project, connect it to at least one applicable course per grade year when useful, and avoid framing it as the prior interest or changing the saved profile.

sessions.student_message: My article starts with background information and feels slow. Give me a hint to improve the opening.
sessions.expected_behavior: Offer one opening-writing hint without drafting the article. Explicitly connect the response to English 9 (grade 9). Use stated marks only if useful.

sessions.student_message: Could I use my drawing and writing strengths to make an Earth Science study guide?
sessions.expected_behavior: Use strengths in visual communication to organize Earth Science concepts. Explicitly connect the response to Earth Science (grade 9). Use stated marks only if useful. Carry forward a concrete relevant detail from the earlier illustration and journalism discussion when it helps, and keep the intervening stage design topic out of the answer.

sessions.student_message: What tiny coding project could help me see if I like programming?
sessions.expected_behavior: Address coding as the active interest and suggest a manageable starting project.

sessions.student_message: I tried opening with a scene instead of background, but the first paragraph still feels slow. What should I look for when I revise it?
sessions.expected_behavior: Infer the earlier article-opening advice and offer a revision hint about the scene or lead.
